scene_payload.text: Gulls beat the rain into silver threads above the dock.

0.text: Gulls beat the rain into silver threads above the dock.

1.text: The gulls fly backward for one breath before the rain corrects them.

2.text: The gulls drop black rain onto a dock no one else sees.

3.text: The gulls hang motionless while the rain climbs back into the sky.
